findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: inkflow_register, inkflow_order · Private data: inkflow_write_free_chapter, inkflow_register, inkflow_balance, inkflow_topup, inkflow_sell_your_lora, inkflow_order · Public sink: inkflow_write_free_chapter, inkflow_register, inkflow_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: inkflow_register, inkflow_order · Private data: inkflow_write_free_chapter, inkflow_register, inkflow_balance, inkflow_topup, inkflow_sell_your_lora, inkflow_order · Public sink: inkflow_write_free_chapter, inkflow_register, inkflow_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "inkflow_write_free_chapter" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
